comparison.objective: Remove four HELICOIL tangs; record adjusts a luggage pull handle to a marked length and leaves its pin locked.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate stabilizes and strikes a small mandrel, then recovers fragments; record unlocks, translates, and re-engages a telescoping detent mechanism.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contained free tangs and undamaged retained inserts; record requires the handle at its working setting, pin engaged, hands withdrawn, and a two-second hold. The record has no available task spec with numeric rubric details.
comparison.reason: Detent release and relatching do not test fracture, controlled impact, or fragment containment.
